_doc: Published 13 TeV measurements used in the comparison figures, verified against the papers on 16 Sep 2026 (arXiv PDF/LaTeX and HEPData). Values in pb, uncertainties as quoted. 'window' is the Born-level mass window; ATLAS 66-116 GeV values are moved to 60-120 GeV with window_scale.
